A woman trapped in Nepal's devastating floods was rescued by the Nepal Army. She has lost everything - her home, her family, everything she had. She sits in shock, with fear visible on her face, as if she still cannot believe what has suddenly happened to her. The Nepal Army deserves immense appreciation for risking their own lives to save people trapped in these dangerous conditions. The devastation in Nepal is truly heartbreaking. So many lives have been lost, families have been torn apart, and countless people have lost their homes and everything they had. It is heartbreaking to witness the scale of this disaster.💔

🚨 A 6-year-old girl was rescued alive after spending approximately 55 to 60 hours trapped beneath flood debris in Timure, Rasuwa District, Nepal. Members of Nepal’s Armed Police Force worked through mud and wreckage before reaching the child, identified in reports as Manisha, and safely pulling her from the destruction. 🙏 The girl received immediate medical assistance and was reportedly transferred to Kathmandu for further care. Information about her parents remained unclear following the rescue, which has become a powerful moment of hope amid the devastating floods that have claimed numerous lives across Nepal. #Nepal #Rasuwa #Rescue #Floods #SurvivalStory

The devastating flood in Rasuwa has caused severe damage along the Bhotekoshi River and the Rasuwagadhi border corridor. Dramatic footage from the Chinese side shows just how powerful the floodwaters were as they reached the immigration office area. The disaster has also disrupted the crucial China–Nepal trade route ahead of Dashain and Tihar, raising concerns over major losses in imports and government revenue. #RasuwaFlood #Rasuwagadhi #NepalFlood #BhotekoshiRiver #nepalnews

Your child spends the summer holidays in Nepal with his grandparents… and comes back taller and slightly different. 😂🇳🇵 Not performed. Not forced. Just sitting on the floor, eating dhido with his hands and casually testing his chilli tolerance, even with the nose shuffles. 🌶️😭 And this is exactly why raising a multicultural child means more to us than simply telling him where he comes from. We want him to experience it. Live it. Spend time with family. Eat the food. Hear the language. And build his own relationship with every part of who he is. After a summer surrounded by family in Nepal, you can definitely tell his Nepali side has been activated. 😂🇳🇵 Anyone else’s child come back from visiting their grandparents with a whole new personality? 😂 #growingupglobal #nepaliculture #nepalifood #multiculturalfamily  #familytimetogether

Kerosene stove fire broke out today at Hotel Good Luck at 10 AM, the heavy wooden insulation inside lodges at high altitudes can make flames spread within minutes. With village water pipes frozen deep under snow, 100+ locals, guides and trekkers fought the flames by hand to save rest of the property. Zero casualties, and neighboring lodges immediately took in every stranded guest and helped them. A massive reminder of the risks local lodge owners carry, and how Khumbu community always backs each other up. #nepal #trekkinginnepal
